title: Singapore Grand Prix

overview.about: The Singapore Grand Prix made history in 2008 as Formula 1's first-ever night race, run under floodlights around the Marina Bay street circuit. Brutally hot and humid, with walls close on both sides and one of the longest lap times of the year, it is one of the most physically punishing races on the calendar. Sebastian Vettel's five wins lead the way. The 2026 race is on 9-11 October.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Singapore Grand Prix runs 9-11 October under the lights at Marina Bay, past the city's illuminated skyline. Safety cars are almost guaranteed on the tight, bumpy streets, and drivers can lose several kilos in a single race in the tropical heat.

@graph.description: The Singapore Grand Prix is Formula 1’s night race on the Marina Bay Street Circuit. Its 2008 debut made it Formula 1’s first full night race, and the temporary street layout uses central Singapore roads under floodlights. Heat, humidity, close walls and a long race duration make the event a distinct challenge for drivers and teams. The existing OneSliders page records the event date in its Event JSON-LD, and the data file preserves that source-backed calendar rather than generating a new one. Practice, qualifying and the Grand Prix are the core Formula 1 sessions. The official organiser’s guidance is the appropriate source for the precise timetable, ticket terms and access arrangements around the street circuit.
